Kedar Pandey was the Chief Minister of Bihar for 15 months from the year 1972. Kedar Pandey was a freedom fighter, strict administrator and known for his tremendous effort to curb cheating and unfair means or practices in board and universities examination. Kedar Pandey was appointed as a cabinet minister during Indira Gandhi's second regime and got railways portfolio. Watch this latest episode of The Lallantop's special political series named Mukhyamantri by Editor Saurabh Dwivedi for more details.
